FluentCxFloatingButton.IsVisible: Gets or sets if the button is visible.
FluentCxFloatingButton.OnKeyDown: Gets or sets the callback when a key is pressed when the button is focused.
FluentCxFloatingButton.OnMouseEnter: Gets or sets the callback when the mouse enters the button.
FluentCxFloatingButton.Position: Gets or sets the position of the floating button.
FluentCxFloatingButton.RelativeContainerId: Gets or sets the identifier of the relative container the current button belongs to.

FloatingPosition.__summary__: Represents the position of the floating button.
FloatingPosition.BottomCenter: The button is placed at the bottom center based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.BottomLeft: The button is placed at the bottom left based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.BottomRight: The button is placed at the bottom right based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.MiddleCenter: The button is placed at the middle center based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.MiddleLeft: The button is placed at the middle left based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.MiddleRight: The button is placed at the middle right based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.TopCenter: The button is placed at the top center based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.TopLeft: The button is placed at the top left based on its relative parent container.
FloatingPosition.TopRight: The button is placed at the top right based on its relative parent container.
